description: History accumulates, a summary checkpoint is taken, the writer is killed abruptly, and a later prompt continues. kill is the suite's abrupt restart mode: interrupt against an idle agent cannot prove reap until the ACP input-cancellation prerequisite in the design's section 12.1 lands, so it is deliberately absent here. Passing requires the same checkpoint-chain continuity the clean restart demands, after an owned process group was genuinely terminated and reaped.
